text:
deploy-bot: publish blocked to prod: ECR publish lock triggered. manifest digest from staging != candidate tag 'release-2026.02.14'. cosign attestation present but content-hash mismatch, refusing promotion. logs: s3://releases/logs/1725301111

gina: ugh, saw the alert. which digest did staging have vs candidate?

samir: staging digest: sha256:aa11bb22cc33, candidate tag resolving to sha256:ff44ee55dd66. both were built from the same CI job id but different manifests. looks like metadata ordering changed in the image layer tar.

kevin: do we have a pinned digest for the canary? we should fallback to the last known-good digest if promotion fails.

release-coordinator: agree. proposed immediate action: rollback prod to sha256:aa11bb22cc33 (canary already on it), mark current tag as quarantined, open a republish window at 18:00 UTC after root-cause and fix. any objections? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

gina: no objections. also adding a short rollback note to release notes and notify customers on the status page.

samir: quick diagnostic commands i ran:
```
# check manifests
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/runtime --image-ids imageTag=release-2026.02.14 --query 'images[0].imageDigest' --output text
skopeo inspect --raw docker://111122223333.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime:release-2026.02.14 | jq -r '.'
```
Results show differing config.digest and layer order changed. probable nondeterministic tar creation in the build step.

kevin: infra-bot, create incident ticket and set priority P2 for deploy pipeline.

infra-bot: created ticket INF-7421 "ECR publish: manifest digest skew preventing promotion" and attached deploy logs. link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-7421

release-coordinator: tagging decision: immediate: rollback prod to sha256:aa11bb22cc33 and pin release-2026.02.14 -> sha256:quarantined-<opaque> to prevent accidental repromote. add release note: "Automated promotion blocked due to manifest mismatch; rolling back to previous digest. Affected customers: none (backend-only change)."

gina: i'll run the rollback now and update deploybot.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated to sha256:aa11bb22cc33. estimated completion 3m.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. prod now at sha256:aa11bb22cc33.

samir: i'll push a CI change to normalize image metadata ordering (tar deterministic pack) and add an integration check to compare produced digest vs canonical build artefact before tagging. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/build/merge-req/512

gina: created release note entry and communicated to oncall. schedule republish to staging after PR lands and CI completes.

kevin: after staging republish and canary pass, we'll do a manual promote and keep quarantine timeout 4h. pls add a regression test to prevent future nondeterministic manifests.

release-coordinator: adding postmortem checklist to INF-7421 and tagging owners. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
